## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` was run, and `dist/` and `docs/lib/` are committed and up to date.
- [ ] `npm run test:node` passes. `npm test` passes when the library or the demo changed.
- [ ] No runtime dependency was added.
- [ ] `crumple.d.ts`, the README (English and Portuguese) and `CHANGELOG.md` agree with any API change.
- [ ] Visual changes have before and after screenshots or a short clip below.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, ...).
